$description: Spacing grids. space.N = N x base (px). The step set is what the semantic layer aliases, so every preset keeps the default steps and may add more.

presets.label: 4 px unit
presets.description: Every space is a multiple of 4 px, with 2 px half steps. Divides common type and control sizes cleanly. The default.

presets.label: 2 px unit
presets.description: Fine 2 px unit for dense tools that need hairline adjustments; the same step names give half the default distances, so extra large steps are added.

presets.label: 8 px unit
presets.description: Coarser 8 px unit with 4 px half steps. Quick to apply and roomy; every default distance doubles.

presets.label: 10 px unit
presets.description: Round 10 px unit with 5 px half steps, for teams that think in tens. Not taken from a published system.

presets.label: 5 px unit (static)
presets.description: A 5 px unit, in the spirit of public-service systems whose line heights are multiples of 5. Static: no responsive shrink.
